text: So Im from Singapore, my partner checked this out. We were just staying at Centara 150m from the clinic so we searched close by dentist. All the other researches were too much too far to go. And I wanted some less touristy and local dentists. This Betty Smile was it! There was only 2 staffs manning the clinic. 1 is Dentist Dr B and assistant Sang. The dental assistant Sang, she explained very well when we asked for bridge/crown replacement. Though we ended up only doing filling because the crown needed 5 to 7 days for 6 crowns. The price chart was on the glass door and also on the reception. Very reasonable 800bht per surface filling. Dentist Dr B was super duper soft and gentle. Very pleasant tooth filling experience for an hour about for 9 fillings. I asked them if its ok if I write a review for them. Im so blessed to find them. I told them we want to come back to do crown when we come back in december. Overall I highly recommend this clinic but please dont bring your bad vibe there. Cannot thank you enough Sang and Dr B to make our experience so pleasant!

I'd like to thank the professional
and caring staff from Betty Smile. If I had the time during my short holiday to Bangkok, I would  have had all the procedures done with them.

I was treated by Dr. Samarat. She explained all the costs and fees before the treatment. She was very attentive, constantly asking if I was in pain and asking me to raise my hand if it hurt, but I didn't need to because she has such a gentle touch. I was very impressed.
This was my first time here. The doctor gave great advice, and the assistants were lovely and spoke very politely. Everyone was very friendly and the price was reasonable.
The doctor is skilled and the service is good.
